integrity: The proof is analytic and uses the published exact defect decomposition, dense range, finite-dimensional linear algebra, and an explicit sign classification. No finite experiment or sampled computation is used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies exactly when the optimal weighted coefficient equals one, but it does not compute the exact coefficient on the noninteger bands between zero and \(m-1\). An older equivalent statement under interrupter or supraposinormal terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact unit-strength regime for generalized Cesàro self-commutator bounds
